title: Reading a game in four stops
author: viewer demo
summary: A worked example of the clip format against a bundled local replay. Open it with `?view=clip&clip=/clips-demo.json`.

items.markdown:
This clip walks one **local** game. Each stop below loads the same replay and seeks to a recorded position, so the board, timeline, and eval graph stay live underneath.

Use the arrow keys: up and down move between stops, left and right step the replay.

items.caption: First real main phase. The board is set and the turn opens with the usual fork: **develop** the bench or commit the hand card now.
An `AttachFrom` sub-decision. Which Pokemon receives the energy is the whole decision here — the rest of the turn is already spent.
A forced switch. Three of the five bench slots are defensible answers, and the recording only shows one of them.

lines.label: Promote the third bench slot
lines.note: Keeps the attacker in reserve at the cost of a slower board.
